decisions.content: Any extra features added beyond the basic ones should be hidden and not visible without something being opened or special effort.
As we move into production, we will focus design thinking on shape, materials, and themes or series that run throughout the product line.
If the corporate colour scheme allows it, the product should have a very bright colour so that it can be easily identified anywhere.
If voice activation is implemented there must always be a button alternative, possibly hidden in the opened-up section.
Plastic and rubber can be used together in the case design.
Style is the top priority, innovative design/technology is required as the second priority, and ease of use is the third priority.
The basic components available are buttons, a wheel (like a mouse scroll wheel), and an LCD display.
The basic functions of the device must include changing channels and changing volume.
The buttons should be easy to press and very comfortable.
The buttons should be large and not tiny.
The case unit itself will be one special colour.
The chosen interface is the third option consisting of one and the LCD display.
The corporate colour will be yellow and the design should consider lemon/yellow elements.
The design should avoid confusing labeling such as having the up and down volume buttons both marked with a V_.
The design should definitely avoid the big square block look.
The device needs some power source, for example a battery, to keep it going.
The facilitator decided participants can take as long as they like on the whiteboard exercise and should not feel rushed.
The industrial designer will be working on the actual working design of the product.
The new remote control design must incorporate the company's corporate colour and slogan.
The next meeting will be in thirty minutes.
The participants decided that advanced functions should be accessed by flipping the remote open (a flip-open/drawer mechanism).
The participants decided that having actual numbers for channels (individual channel selection) is required.
The participants decided that production cost is the main factor to consider for the design.
The participants decided that the essential functions required are on/off, volume, channel, and skipping to certain channels with the numbers.
The participants decided that things that would be nice to have include audio set up, display set up, and a mute button.
The participants decided the buttons will be normal coloured buttons without the colour differentiation for the pad.
The participants decided the device height will be about two and a half centimetres.
The participants decided the device should be relatively deep—deep enough to be comfortable to hold rather than wide and flat.
The participants decided the device width will be about three centimetres.
The participants decided they are not going to have the LCD anymore and instead will show status on the TV.
The participants decided they do not need to include teletext, VCR controls, or display controls like brightness and contrast.
The participants decided they will chat for about five minutes at most.
The participants decided to have the embossing on just one button.
The participants decided to modularise the system so that each component represents one function.
The participants decided to move on to the next presentation.
The participants decided to stay with the tried-and-tested infra-red transmission rather than exploring new transmission technologies.
The participants decided to stick to the UI person's area for the discussion.
The product should look good and be easy to use and these are big priorities.
The product will be made of plastic and not use rubber in the buttons.
The product will focus on the TV as specified in the new requirement spec.
The project will move next into the functional design stage.
The remote control's main design aim will be to combine controls for multiple devices such as satellite, regular TV, VCR, etc.

decisions.decision_object: appearance should be cool and gimmicky
decisions.content: The remote control should look kind of cool and gimmicky.
The remote control will include a feature that allows you to make a high pitched sound or whistle to make the remote beep so you can find it.
The remote control will include extra functionalities such as controlling the lighting in the house and storing notes about what you want to watch.
The remote control will only be used to control the television and will not control the VCR, DVD or other devices.
The stand-by button should be red.
The target market was decided to be the mid range to the high end market (middle up-ish) rather than the low end.
The team adopted a requirement to ignore everything except the TV.
The team adopted a requirement to ignore teletext.
The team adopted a requirement to try to incorporate the corporate colour and slogan.
The team decided the design will proceed in three stages with individual work followed by a meeting, repeated three times.
The team decided the product will be non-rechargeable battery-powered.
The team decided the target group will be fifteen to thirty five.
The team decided they will do individual work and then have a meeting about it, and repeat that process three times.
The team decided they will group audio-visual and other functions into categories.
The team decided to aim the product at a sort of young professional demographic.
The team decided to allow speech recognition to be activated and deactivated (an on/off option) in the product.
The team decided to follow current trends in materials and shapes and styles for the product's aesthetics while not letting those trends confine the technology.
The team decided to group different functions together and make the optional technology modular so users can access basic functions easily while advanced features are optional.
The team decided to prioritise their design features based on the collected customer information.
The team decided to start with customer needs and begin with the customer to understand what they want.
The team decided to target the fifteen to thirty five age group as their target market for the product.
The team decided to try out the whiteboard by drawing their favourite animal and summing up their favourite characteristics of it.
The team will not include teletext functionality because the company has decided teletext is outdated and nobody uses it much anymore.
The user interface / technical functions person will be responsible for what the product will actually do.
The voice control should be able to talk back to confirm any action the user takes.
They decided that the advanced functions will be hidden in the L_C_D_ panel and accessed via the jog-dial.
They decided the button width will be three and a half (centimetres).
They decided the buttons should be about one centimetre each and the overall remote height should be about ten centimetres.
They decided the device will use just battery power and will not include kinetic power.
They decided the jog-dial will be used for more advanced functions like contrast and colour.
They decided the production cost must not exceed twelve fifty Euros, which is fifty percent of the selling price.
They decided the red button will act as the power button and if held for maybe two seconds it'll send a stand-by signal.
They decided the red button will be used as a confirm button for the LCD screen.
They decided the remote control will be sold on an international scale.
They decided to have the foggy yellow colour from last time that lit up when you pushed the button.
They decided to include a number pad on the remote.
They decided to include a very basic, very small L_C_D_ screen with access to the menu through the scroll wheel and confirm button.
They decided to include basic audio tone controls such as bass, mid-range, and high-range.
They decided to include left-right balance as an audio setting.
They decided to include the possibility of pre-programmed sound modes that the user could determine and select.
They decided to sell the remote control for twenty five Euro.
They decided to take away the LCD display and also remove the advanced chip, replacing it with a regular chip.
They decided to use the jog-dial for volume control.
They decided users can skip straight to a channel using these buttons.
They set a sales target of fifty million Euro.
We will avoid creating electronics that are literal novelty shapes such as a remote control in the shape of an apple.
We will capitalize on the trend toward soft, spongy, ergonomic, friendly-to-handle materials because many competitors are still in last year's harder, glossier mode.

decisions.decision_object: visual and tactile attributes to emphasize
decisions.content: We will emphasize vibrant natural colours, softness in materials, and friendly shape and function in the product design.

decisions.decision_object: treatment of fashion trend (fruit and vegetables)
decisions.content: We will observe the emerging fashion trend of fruit and vegetables rather than fully adopt it literally.
We will take some features of high-tech devices like the Mac iPod but make the product more comfortable and more vibrant/friendly to hold.
